title: Guidance on Decision-Making
summary: Prophet Muhammad advised considering the outcomes before action.
translation: One should always engage in actions whose outcomes are known to be good from the beginning, and not be under the misconception or optimistic assumption that they will easily be completed. Rather, one should look ahead, consider thoroughly, and seek advice before undertaking actions known to have beneficial outcomes. A person asked the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) for guidance on actions and affairs so that they would not fail. The Prophet (peace be upon him) advised that whenever you intend to undertake an action, reflect, examine the outcome, and carefully consider all aspects. If you see religious goodness in undertaking it, then proceed. But if you sense any worldly or religious misguidance or fear for the hereafter, avoid it. This is a decisive directive from the Prophet (peace be upon him) concerning actions, and all should incorporate this guidance into their lives.
